## Slack Daily Summary

Webhook-driven mock channel digest for the Agent Operations Portal demo.

Contract:
- Inbound: spec §12.1 (execution_id, callback{url,secret}, input.items[])
- Callback: spec §12.2 (status, metrics, result)
- Result schema: spec §14.3 (summary, risks[], action_items[].owner|task|priority)

Deterministic theming so the same input always yields the same digest. Tune the keyword maps in the Code node to add channels/topics.
